content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum (SCTIMST), a premier autonomous institute under the Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post being recruited?
faq.answer: The institute is recruiting candidates for the post of Project Technical Support II under a foreign-funded research project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support II position on a temporary contract basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Eligible candidates are required to directly report to the designated venue with necessary documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 26 October 2026 at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS building.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BSW/BA in Sociology or BSc in Life Sciences with 2 years of experience, OR an MSW/MA in Sociology with 1 year of experience in research or field data collection.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxations apply as per institutional norms.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 24,000 per month plus an additional Rs. 4,000 as a fixed travel allowance for field visits.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary on a contract basis for an initial period of six months, subject to project requirements and performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can check the official SCTIMST website at www.sctimst.ac.in or refer to the notification released under advertisement number R&P Cell/44/5510/SCTIMST/2026.
